channel: complex white Gaussian noise of variance 10^(-SNR/10) fs/R per sample: the SNR over the symbol rate, Es/N0 = Eb/N0
count: ber: bits 2 to 1024, the example's; errors_from_bit_3: bits 3 to 1024 (the encoder of Optilux starts its recursion at the second symbol without the first, so the second bit is decided against the wrong reference)
name: dpsk
receiver: the movavg optical filter of bandwidth 2 R, H(f) = sinc(f/R) (the integrator over one symbol), the one-symbol delay interferometer and the balanced photodiode, data-aided timing, the sign decision
script: tools/record_optilux_dpsk.m: the chain of Examples/ex15_dtc_dpsk_ber.m with the stopping rule 3 % at 95 % confidence or 1e7 bits, and the real part of the two complex arrays that Octave compares by their moduli
signal: binary DPSK, 10 GBd, the costails pulse of roll-off 0.01 at 32 samples per symbol (a rectangle of one symbol), 1 mW, 1024 symbols, seed 1 (Optilux's pattern)
